about: Which of the city's milieu types (register.milieu, from the city's milieu typing of its centre, GIS:Turun_keskustan_miljootyypitys, field Tyyppi) count as the town: the city centre's streets of town blocks and the old wooden quarters people have moved back into. The town-only rules of archetypes.py (in_town) apply there and nowhere else; a building outside every milieu zone is not in the town. Chosen 2026-11-13 by w2-buildings from where the evidence of those rules was photographed; for Jonni to confirm or change.

town.Liikekeskusta: business centre: shops, cafes and offices in the ground storeys of the grid (Kauppiaskatu 6, Aurakatu 1)
town.Historiallinen Turku: historic Turku by the river and the cathedral: old town houses with restaurants (Sergio's, Läntinen Rantakatu 27)
town.Avokorttelimiljöö: open blocks of the centre grid: old town houses among later blocks (Linnankatu 29)
town.Mäkipuistomiljöö: the centre's hill quarters round the parks: old stone and wooden blocks (Puutarhakatu 9a)
town.Puukaupunkimiljöö: wooden town: the old wooden quarters, renovated and lived in, with corner shops and cafes (Puutarhakatu 42a)

not_town.Julkisten rakennusten miljöö: public buildings: schools, hospitals, churches; their own types
not_town.Jälleenrakennuskauden kerrostalomiljöö: post-war blocks of flats: no old ancillary houses, few shops
not_town.Muuttuva kaupunkiympäristö: changing districts, former harbour and industry: old ancillary buildings there are stores and works
not_town.Teollisuusmenneisyyteen pohjautuva miljö: industrial past: old sheds and halls are what the register says
not_town.Saapumisen miljöö: arrival routes and the harbour: halls and stations
not_town.Pienomakotitalomiljöö: small detached houses: an old ancillary building there is a yard shed or a sauna
